Exchanges: bull+rope→shop cutscene→boltcutters; cut wire→phone→witch→broom; broom→hedgepig→needle; show needle→camel→dung→coin; sand bucket→engineer→dynamite; gold→teacher→MAKE BODY skill; leaflet→Bod Addit→sharp wit; humpty push+rock→shells→Day-Vee→hammer; hut LARM; coin→Angus McBonyhead (castle tollkeeper); game→Balrog.

Descent: cut rope (required sharp wit) → cellar → pull nails (hammer) → playwright drops flashlight → light it → tunnel → West Bank → wear tube, swim → East Bank → cavern: drop dynamite, light, w, z, z → blast → tavern → turn bracket → tunnel → glade → eat pills → ride pony → ENDING.

## Key parser lessons (for the assistant dataset)
- Buildings are entered with bare `in`; ENTER/GO DOOR are not supported.
- GIVE rejects unknown recipient nouns with the generic 'That's not possible at the moment.', and wrong-item gives with the NPC catch-all 'No thanks, you keep it' — neither disambiguates the real requirement.
- TALK takes no object and is never progress-relevant; BUY has no valid use in this port.
- Body parts only take by abbreviation (RARM/LARM/LLEG); FILL takes no WITH-clause; SMASH is listed but only the hammer's scripted uses succeed.
- Timed hazard (dynamite) required retreat + two waits; keypress pauses were safely passed with the next queued command or an empty command at the end screen.
